W.note: Restrained violet glow with a long asymmetric tail and a sensible settle curve, but the pale primary reads like a secondary button and the page is dominated by a dial panel.

X.note: Aura, sheen and a drifting gradient give the most literal dreamlike hover with solid reduced-motion and focus handling, though the 1.1 to 1.6 s durations feel slow and overflow hidden clips the aura.

Y.note: Most polished pairing of hover bloom, gradient drift and custom curves on a strong layout with full reduced-motion and focus handling; the hover crops missed the button, so this is judged mainly from source.

Z.note: Most practical, with a high-contrast label, a slow glow tail, real glass and rebound dials, and reduced-motion and focus covered, but the solid navy focal is less ethereal and the pill note wraps awkwardly on phone.
